articles.summary: Savers Value Village, Inc. (NYSE: SVV), (the “Company”) today announced preliminary net sales for the fourteen weeks ended January 3, 2026 (the "fourth quarter") and the fifty-three weeks ended January 3, 2026 ("fiscal 2025") in conjunction with the Company’s participation in the ICR Conference January 12-14, 2026. The Company’s results for both the fourth quarter and full year ended January 3, 2026 included the benefit of one additional week (the "53rd week") relative to the prior year comparative periods. The Company reported the following results on a preliminary and unaudited basis. Fourth Quarter 1 : Total Company net sales increased 15.6% to $464.7 million. Excluding the benefit of the 53rd week, net sales increased 8.4%, constant-currency net sales 2 increased 8.4% and comparable store sales increased 5.4%. articles.title: Savers Value Village, Inc. Announces Preliminary Fourth Quarter and Full Year Net Sales and Participation in the 28th Annual ICR Conference
